title: Environment variables

page.notFound: This environment variable does not exist. It may have been deleted.

table.label: Environment variables
table.empty: No environment variables yet. Add one to give every coding session's agent a setting or token.
table.loadError: Environment variables could not be loaded.

form.keyHint: Letters, digits, and underscores, not starting with a digit, such as NPM_TOKEN.
form.valueHint: Passed exactly as written, including spaces and line breaks.
form.valueKeep: Leave blank to keep the current value.
form.valueReveal: Enter the value again to make this variable visible.
form.isSecretHint: Hidden from Elysium and session logs. The agent can still read it.

errors.keyTaken: Another variable already uses this key.

keyRefusal.malformed: Use a letter or underscore, then letters, digits, or underscores.
keyRefusal.reservedForElysium: Elysium sets this variable for GitHub.
keyRefusal.reservedForRunner: Elysium sets this variable for every agent turn.
keyRefusal.modelCredential: This decides the model credential an agent runs on. Add credentials under Settings, LLMs instead.

errors.valueRequired: A secret variable needs a value.

delete.title: Delete {{key}}?
delete.body: Sessions opened from now on no longer receive {{key}}. Sessions already running keep it.

help: Every coding session's agent receives these variables, and can read, print, or send any of them. Secret only hides a value from Elysium and its session logs, so anything the agent must not see does not belong here.
